home_title.en: HTML to Markdown via Headless Chrome for Go | go-browser
home_title.zh: Go 爬蟲：動態網頁轉 Markdown｜go-browser

en.home: go-browser by Pardn Chiu (邱敬幃, pardnchiu) is a Go web scraping library that renders in headless Chrome and turns a URL to Markdown for LLMs, HTML or JSON.
en.getting-started: Install go-browser with go get, check the Chrome and keyring prerequisites, run a first Fetch call that returns Markdown, and close cached browsers.
en.getting-started-troubleshooting: What each go-browser error means: http 403, 429, 503, 404 and 204 status errors, invalid url, readability failures, and SameSession keychain errors.
en.agenvoy: How the Agenvoy AI agent uses go-browser: fetch_page, download_file and search_web options, Chrome login reuse, failed-URL skipping, and result handling.
en.architecture: How go-browser is layered: fetch routing, the browser launcher, Chrome cookie decryption, the Markdown pipeline, and how Agenvoy's AI agent tools call it.
en.core-concepts: The eleven ordered steps of one go-browser Fetch call, from URL validation and routing through settling, consent and scrolling to output conversion.
en.core-concepts-routing: How go-browser picks headless or headed Chrome: Option.Visible and social session domains go headed, other hosts retry headed only on 403, 429 or 503.
en.core-concepts-browser-cache: How go-browser caches Chrome by headless mode and User-Agent, evicts idle instances after five minutes, and caps concurrent pages with SetMaxConcurrency.
en.core-concepts-cookie-session: How SameSession copies your Chrome cookie database, decrypts v10 and v11 cookies with PBKDF2 and AES-128-CBC, and injects them into a throwaway browser.
en.core-concepts-snapshots: How go-browser waits for the load event, decides a page has settled with DOM stability and requestIdleCallback, then scrolls to capture lazy content.
en.core-concepts-consent: How go-browser dismisses cookie consent banners via known platform selectors, accept text or overlay removal, while leaving login walls and paywalls alone.
en.core-concepts-anti-detection: The anti-detection measures in go-browser: AutomationControlled disabled, stealth.js navigator patches, paced scrolling, and the headed fallback.
en.configuration: Every go-browser Option field with its default: IdleWait, MaxLength, UserAgent, KeepLinks, Viewport, SameSession, Headless, Visible, Type and ScrollCount.
en.configuration-output-formats: What go-browser returns for TypeMarkdown, TypeHTML and TypeJSON, which Result fields each fills, and how JSON and XML documents bypass conversion.
en.configuration-environment: Host settings go-browser reads: DISPLAY and WAYLAND_DISPLAY, Chrome binary lookup order, Chrome profile paths, and commands used by SameSession.
en.api-reference: go-browser API reference for Fetch, Close and SetMaxConcurrency, with parameters, retry behavior and an index of every exported symbol.
en.api-reference-conversion: HTMLToMarkdown, HTMLToNode, Merge, DedupTree, DedupMarkdownParagraphs and InlineTimeElements: element rules, deduplication and edge cases.
en.api-reference-types: The Option, Viewport, Result, Error, Node and Browser types in go-browser, the TypeMarkdown, TypeHTML and TypeJSON constants, and ErrProfileNotFound.
en.removed-api: Symbols removed from go-browser: the tab API removed in v0.3.2, the goBrowser to browser rename, and the v0.2.0 move to the core package.

zh.home: 邱敬幃（Pardn Chiu，pardnchiu）的 Go 爬蟲函式庫：以 Chrome 渲染動態網頁、擷取主要內容，將網頁轉 Markdown 給 LLM。
zh.getting-started: 以 go get 安裝 go-browser、確認 Chrome 前置需求、第一次 Fetch 取得 Markdown 並關閉瀏覽器。
zh.getting-started-troubleshooting: go-browser 錯誤對照：http 403／429／503／404／204、invalid url、readability 與鑰匙圈錯誤。
zh.agenvoy: Agenvoy AI agent 如何使用 go-browser：fetch_page、download_file、search_web 的選項、沿用 Chrome 登入、失敗略過與結果處理。
zh.architecture: go-browser 分層：Fetch 路由、瀏覽器啟動器、Cookie 解密與 Markdown 管線，以及 Agenvoy 的 AI agent 工具如何呼叫它。
zh.core-concepts: 一次 Fetch 依序執行的十一個步驟：驗證、路由、等待穩定、同意橫幅、捲動與輸出轉換。
zh.core-concepts-routing: go-browser 如何選擇 headless 或有頭 Chrome：Visible 與社群網域直接有頭，其餘僅在 403／429／503 時有頭重試。
zh.core-concepts-browser-cache: 以 headless 與 User-Agent 快取 Chrome、閒置 5 分鐘回收，並以 SetMaxConcurrency 限制併發。
zh.core-concepts-cookie-session: SameSession 複製並解密本機 Chrome Cookie（PBKDF2＋AES-128-CBC），注入一次性瀏覽器讀取登入頁。
zh.core-concepts-snapshots: 等待 load 事件（上限 10 秒）、以 DOM 穩定與 requestIdleCallback 判定載入完成，再捲動擷取延遲載入內容的快照。
zh.core-concepts-consent: 以已知平台選擇器、同意字樣或移除遮罩關閉 Cookie 同意橫幅，不碰登入牆與付費牆。
zh.core-concepts-anti-detection: go-browser 反偵測：停用 AutomationControlled、stealth.js 修改 navigator、擬人化捲動與有頭降級。
zh.configuration: go-browser Option 欄位與預設值：IdleWait、MaxLength、KeepLinks、Viewport、Visible、Type 等。
zh.configuration-output-formats: TypeMarkdown、TypeHTML、TypeJSON 的回傳內容與填入欄位，以及 JSON／XML 文件的直通路徑。
zh.configuration-environment: go-browser 讀取的主機設定：DISPLAY、Chrome 執行檔與設定檔路徑、SameSession 外部指令。
zh.api-reference: go-browser 的 Fetch、Close、SetMaxConcurrency 參數與重試行為，以及全部匯出符號索引。
zh.api-reference-conversion: HTMLToMarkdown、HTMLToNode、Merge、DedupTree 等六個轉換函式的規則、去重與邊界。
zh.api-reference-types: go-browser 的 Option、Result、Error、Node 等型別，輸出格式常數與 ErrProfileNotFound。
zh.removed-api: go-browser 已移除符號：v0.3.2 的分頁 API、goBrowser 更名 browser、v0.2.0 搬到 core。
